item.title: NORAD Santa Tracker: Follow Santa Claus' journey across the world | LIVE
item.description: Norad tracks Santa Claus' flight around the world on Christmas Eve.

item.title: Rob and Michele Reiner death certificates reveal new details
item.description: Actor-director Rob Reiner and his wife Michele Singer Reiner died minutes after they were stabbed multiple times, according to the couple's death certificates.

item.title: Investigators sift through wreckage after a deadly Pennsylvania nursing home explosion
item.description: An apparent gas explosion collapsed part of a nursing home in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, leaving two women dead and 20 hospitalized.

item.title: Person missing in Texas plane crash confirmed dead, bringing death toll to 6, Mexican Navy says
item.description: Shriners Children's confirmed the plane was transporting a child to their facility for burn care before officials say the aircraft went down, killing six people.

item.title: California launches aggressive crackdown on extreme speeding
item.description: The California State Transportation Agency has announced a pilot program to crack down on excessive speeding.

item.title: What inspired Will Arnett's new film, "Is This Thing On?" The star reveals all
item.description: Will Arnett opens up about the inspiration behind his new movie, "Is This Thing On?," in theaters now!

item.title: TIMELINE: More strong storms to bring heavy rain, damaging winds through Christmas
item.description: Our next round of storms arrives after 8 p.m. Wednesday and will continue through Christmas Day with heavy rain and High Wind Warnings for gusts up to 65 mph. ABC7 meteorologist Drew Tuma has a timeline.

item.title: California farmer arrested on suspicion of murder in wife's death in Arizona
item.description: Authorities say a prominent farmer has been arrested on suspicion of murder in the shooting death of his estranged wife.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Heavy rain at times tonight with gusty winds, chance of thunderstorms
item.description: Another Level 3 storm is coming in tonight and it will stick around through Christmas. Expect heavy rain at times, gusty winds and a chance of thunderstorms.

item.title: Second-story Richmond Public Storage Facility collapses in fire
item.description: The fire broke out during the peak of Tuesday night's storm. Richmond Fire Chief Aaron Osorio says the strong winds contributed to the fire spreading.
